name: Letter beads
what: Letter beads lie scattered and roll into a line that spells the word - each turning as it rolls, landing with a tiny bounce; a string pulls through them; they scatter again at the end.

learned_from.what: letter beads scattered on cream rolling into a word and scattering again

motion: beads pop in 10 f; each rolls 14 f (slow end, turning by its distance), 2 f apart, bounces 6 f; the string draws 12 f
